title: A Party Invitation
text:
Maria wants to have a party. She writes invitations for her friends. The party is on Saturday at four o'clock. Please come to my house!

Her friend Tom reads the invitation and smiles. He says yes, he can come. Maria is happy because many friends will come to the party. They will eat cake and play games.

options: He says he will call later.
He says he is too tired.
He says yes, he can come.
He says no, he has a test.

questions.text: How does Maria probably feel about her party?

options: She wants to sell her house.
She wants to learn to write.
She wants to go to school.
She wants her friends to come to her party.

vocabulary.definition: cards or messages that ask someone to come to an event
a social event where people eat, talk and have fun

paragraph_translations: Maria quer fazer uma festa. Ela escreve convites para os seus amigos. A festa é no sábado às quatro horas. Por favor, venha à minha casa!
Seu amigo Tom lê o convite e sorri. Ele diz que sim, ele pode ir. Maria está feliz porque muitos amigos vão à festa. Eles vão comer bolo e brincar de jogos.
